sec17-card-sec17-F10.teaching_text: Adjusting seats, mirrors, belts, shifting, backing straight, and holding imaginary lanes build core muscle memory.

sec17-card-sec17-F11.question_text: Into what neighborhood setting does phase two move, and which four traffic skills get added?
sec17-card-sec17-F11.teaching_text: Calm neighborhood blocks introduce pulling out, simple turns, two-second spacing, and gentle lane shifts safely.

sec17-card-sec17-R06.question_text: Why should a learner's first left turns wait for a quiet street when even right turns demand five steps?
sec17-card-sec17-R06.teaching_text: Even a basic right turn juggles mirrors, blinkers, lane placement, braking, and steering before adding oncoming left-turn gaps.

sec17-card-sec17-F12.question_text: Which five tougher maneuvers and parking skills enter during phase three in heavier traffic?
sec17-card-sec17-F12.teaching_text: Once basic control is automatic, phase three layers busy multi-turn intersections, U-turns, quick stops, and tight parking.

sec17-card-sec17-F13.question_text: Which four high-demand environments round out phase-four supervised practice?
sec17-card-sec17-F13.teaching_text: Experiencing fast interstates, rain, nighttime glare, and heavy city traffic alongside a mentor prevents solo shock.

sec17-card-sec17-F17.question_text: What relationship have safety researchers found between supervised practice miles and solo crash rates?
sec17-card-sec17-F17.teaching_text: Every extra hundred miles logged alongside an experienced co-pilot cuts a novice's solo crash risk.

sec17-card-sec17-R08.question_text: Roughly how many supervised miles does transportation research recommend before a novice drives solo?
sec17-card-sec17-R08.teaching_text: Michigan transportation researchers point to roughly three thousand varied practice miles to build durable hazard recognition.

sec17-card-sec17-F18.question_text: How many supervised driving hours does Tennessee's graduated program require before an intermediate license?
sec17-card-sec17-F18.teaching_text: Completing at least fifty certified behind-the-wheel hours satisfies Tennessee's mandatory graduated practice floor.

sec17-card-sec17-R09.question_text: What easy method does the manual suggest for keeping track of a teen's supervised practice hours?
sec17-card-sec17-R09.teaching_text: Jotting down dates, conditions, and minutes right in the glovebox beats guessing fifty hours later.

sec17-card-sec17-R10.question_text: Which four practical topics can a written family driving agreement spell out ahead of time?
sec17-card-sec17-R10.teaching_text: Putting curfews, gas and insurance sharing, car condition, and ticket consequences in writing prevents family disputes.

sec17-card-sec17-F19.question_text: Roughly what share of sixteen-year-old male and female drivers crash during their first year licensed?
sec17-card-sec17-F19.teaching_text: Knowing twenty percent of sixteen-year-old boys and ten percent of girls wreck within twelve months underscores sobering risk.

sec17-card-sec17-F20.question_text: Which two high-risk factors combine in many of the worst teen crashes, explaining graduated limits?
sec17-card-sec17-F20.teaching_text: Darkness plus peer distraction inside a full car drives severe teen wrecks, justifying curfews and passenger caps.

sec17-card-sec17-R11.question_text: What happens to crash risk when alcohol or drug impairment joins nighttime teen group driving?
sec17-card-sec17-R11.teaching_text: Stacking chemical impairment onto dark roads and noisy passengers compounds fatal crash odds several times over.

sec17-card-sec17-F21.question_text: What mindset becomes a new driver's worst enemy soon after mastering basic vehicle controls?
sec17-card-sec17-F21.teaching_text: Steering smoothly feels easy long before hazard anticipation matures, luring overconfident beginners into preventable wrecks.

sec17-card-sec17-R12.question_text: Why are caution and raw years behind the wheel not enough by themselves for defensive driving?
sec17-card-sec17-R12.teaching_text: Without actively maintaining scanning and spacing habits after test day, sloppy shortcuts quietly replace defensive skill.

sec17-card-sec17-F22.question_text: What spoken communication requirement must every applicant meet before starting a Tennessee road test?
sec17-card-sec17-F22.teaching_text: Because examiners ride solo with applicants, safe testing depends on understanding live spoken route directions.

sec17-card-sec17-R13.question_text: How can a mentor prepare a learner whose first language is not English for traffic signs?
sec17-card-sec17-R13.teaching_text: Translating real roadside warning and guide signs aloud on practice drives builds instant recognition before test day.

sec17-card-sec17-R14.question_text: How can a mentor rehearse the road examiner's role during practice sessions?
sec17-card-sec17-R14.teaching_text: Practicing crisp English prompts like turn left, slow down, or go straight removes language nerves on exam day.

sec17-card-sec17-F23.question_text: Roughly how briefly does an examiner ride with a teen, and what can passing never guarantee?
sec17-card-sec17-F23.teaching_text: A twenty-minute drive checks basic competence on one route, never guaranteeing safe solo choices months later.
sec17-card-sec17-F23.must_match_memory_hook: Under thirty minutes; zero habit guarantee

visual_sync.text_span: Under thirty minutes; zero habit guarantee

sec17-card-sec17-R15.question_text: Why does passing the skills test not prove a teen will drive safely once alone?
sec17-card-sec17-R15.teaching_text: Almost everyone checks mirrors carefully beside a uniformed examiner, then faces real temptation once solo.

sec17-card-sec17-F24.question_text: How do the examiner's job and the parent's or mentor's job divide, even after a license is issued?
sec17-card-sec17-F24.teaching_text: Examiners only score minimum test-day competence, leaving parents responsible for teaching and supervising newly licensed teens.

sec04-card-sec04-F01.question_text: What are the three parts of Tennessee's driver license examination?
sec04-card-sec04-F01.teaching_text: Every full first-time driver clears eyesight, traffic-law knowledge, and behind-the-wheel control before earning a license.
sec04-card-sec04-F01.must_match_memory_hook: Vision screening, knowledge test, road test

visual_sync.text_span: Vision screening, knowledge test, road test

sec04-card-sec04-F02.question_text: Which Driver Service Centers do not offer license exams, and how are written knowledge tests queued?
sec04-card-sec04-F02.teaching_text: Going to an express-only counter wastes a trip, while full-service centers handle written tests first-come, first-served.
sec04-card-sec04-F02.must_match_memory_hook: Skip express centers; knowledge walks in

visual_sync.text_span: Skip express centers; knowledge walks in

sec04-card-sec04-F03.question_text: Why must behind-the-wheel road tests always be scheduled ahead of time rather than walk-in?
sec04-card-sec04-F03.teaching_text: Because each on-road evaluation takes dedicated examiner time, showing up without a booked slot will not get you tested.
sec04-card-sec04-F03.must_match_memory_hook: Road tests run strictly by appointment

visual_sync.text_span: Road tests run strictly by appointment

sec04-card-sec04-F07.question_text: How do the required tests for an original Class D or hardship applicant compare with a learner permit applicant?
sec04-card-sec04-F07.teaching_text: Original passenger and hardship applicants take vision, written, and road tests, whereas learner permits skip the road test for now.
sec04-card-sec04-F07.must_match_memory_hook: Three for licenses, two for permits

visual_sync.text_span: Three for licenses, two for permits

sec04-card-sec04-R02.question_text: Which exams apply when trading a Tennessee learner permit for Class D compared with renewing or replacing a card?
sec04-card-sec04-R02.teaching_text: Upgrading a valid permit needs only vision and road testing, while standard renewals and duplicates skip exams altogether.
sec04-card-sec04-R02.must_match_memory_hook: Vision plus road; renewals take zero

visual_sync.text_span: Vision plus road; renewals take zero

sec04-card-sec04-R03.question_text: Which two screenings or exams are required when adding a For-Hire endorsement?
sec04-card-sec04-R03.teaching_text: For-Hire applicants already hold Class D driving experience, so they complete vision and written testing without repeating a road test.

sec04-card-sec04-F08.question_text: When does a new resident take only the vision check versus taking all three Tennessee exams?
sec04-card-sec04-F08.teaching_text: A current out-of-state license needs only vision screening, while expired cards, foreign arrivals, and unlicensed newcomers take all three.
sec04-card-sec04-F08.must_match_memory_hook: Valid state card vision; otherwise three

visual_sync.text_span: Valid state card vision; otherwise three

sec04-card-sec04-F09.question_text: What visual acuity score must you meet in each eye and both eyes together, with or without corrective lenses?
sec04-card-sec04-F09.teaching_text: Wearing glasses or contacts to hit twenty-over-forty passes cleanly and simply adds a corrective-lens note to your license.
sec04-card-sec04-F09.must_match_memory_hook: Twenty over forty, each and together

visual_sync.text_span: Twenty over forty, each and together

sec04-card-sec04-F10.question_text: What step must an applicant take if they cannot pass the counter vision screening?
sec04-card-sec04-F10.teaching_text: Failing the counter screener is not automatic permanent denial; your chosen eye doctor submits a formal vision form for review.
sec04-card-sec04-F10.must_match_memory_hook: Bring an eye specialist's completed statement

visual_sync.text_span: Bring an eye specialist's completed statement

sec04-card-sec04-F11.question_text: Which manual sections feed the multiple-choice knowledge test, and how is it divided across four topics?
sec04-card-sec04-F11.teaching_text: Studying only road signs leaves three-quarters of the exam exposed across safe driving principles, road rules, and alcohol or drugs.
sec04-card-sec04-F11.must_match_memory_hook: Sections B and C, four quarters

visual_sync.text_span: Sections B and C, four quarters

sec04-card-sec04-F12.question_text: How are knowledge tests normally administered, and which three non-English languages run on computerized terminals?
sec04-card-sec04-F12.teaching_text: Paper exams happen only rarely, while touch-screen kiosks offer English alongside Spanish, Korean, and Japanese.
sec04-card-sec04-F12.must_match_memory_hook: Computer terminals; Spanish, Korean, and Japanese

visual_sync.text_span: Computer terminals; Spanish, Korean, and Japanese

sec04-card-sec04-F13.question_text: What translation help may non-native English speakers use during testing, and what devices or helpers are banned?
sec04-card-sec04-F13.teaching_text: Bringing handwritten notes inside a dictionary, pulling out an electronic translator, or asking a friend to interpret fails the test.
sec04-card-sec04-F13.must_match_memory_hook: Clean dictionary; no electronics or interpreters

visual_sync.text_span: Clean dictionary; no electronics or interpreters

sec04-card-sec04-F14.question_text: Who can schedule an oral knowledge exam at selected centers, and what extra proof must minors under eighteen bring?
sec04-card-sec04-F14.teaching_text: Oral testing requires an appointment, and teens under eighteen must bring a doctor's or educational specialist's written statement first.
sec04-card-sec04-F14.must_match_memory_hook: Reading or learning barriers; doctor's note

visual_sync.text_span: Reading or learning barriers; doctor's note

sec04-card-sec04-R05.question_text: How does the Department of Safety assist a deaf applicant who requests an oral knowledge test?
sec04-card-sec04-R05.teaching_text: While foreign-language interpreters are barred, the state provides a certified sign-language interpreter so deaf applicants get equal access.

sec04-card-sec04-F37.question_text: Which age group may take the written knowledge exam online, and who supervises through the state proctor app?
sec04-card-sec04-F37.teaching_text: Parents or legal guardians verify themselves in the state proctor app to supervise fifteen-to-seventeen-year-olds taking the written test online.
sec04-card-sec04-F37.must_match_memory_hook: Teens fifteen to seventeen, parent proctored

visual_sync.text_span: Teens fifteen to seventeen, parent proctored

sec04-card-sec04-R17.question_text: How does the Tennessee proctor app verify an adult before they supervise an online teen knowledge test?
sec04-card-sec04-R17.teaching_text: Cross-checking the parent's own Department of Safety record blocks impersonation before online teen testing begins.
sec04-card-sec04-R17.must_match_memory_hook: Matches secure identity against state records

visual_sync.text_span: Matches secure identity against state records

sec04-card-sec04-F05.question_text: Can an applicant retake a failed Tennessee driver license exam later on that same day?
sec04-card-sec04-F05.teaching_text: Once an exam attempt ends in failure, state rules lock out another try until at least the next day.
sec04-card-sec04-F05.must_match_memory_hook: Never repeat any test same day

visual_sync.text_span: Never repeat any test same day

sec04-card-sec04-F06.question_text: How much must you pay again each time you fail a learner permit, Class D, or hardship exam?
sec04-card-sec04-F06.teaching_text: Rushing into the kiosk unprepared adds a fresh two-dollar reapplication fee onto every failed attempt.
sec04-card-sec04-F06.must_match_memory_hook: Pay the two-dollar application fee again

visual_sync.text_span: Pay the two-dollar application fee again

sec04-card-sec04-F16.question_text: How long must you wait to retry after failing a knowledge test the first time or on later attempts?
sec04-card-sec04-F16.teaching_text: Unlike road-test error tiers, failing the written knowledge exam carries the same minimum one-day wait after every miss.
sec04-card-sec04-F16.must_match_memory_hook: Wait at least one full day

visual_sync.text_span: Wait at least one full day

sec04-card-sec04-F15.question_text: What two immediate consequences hit anyone caught cheating on a required license exam?
sec04-card-sec04-F15.teaching_text: Getting caught cheating turns what could have been a one-day study reset into an automatic fail and thirty-day lockout.

sec04-card-sec04-R01.question_text: How does the mandatory waiting period compare between failing a knowledge test honestly and getting caught cheating?
sec04-card-sec04-R01.teaching_text: Exam questions pair these waits to highlight that cheating multiplies the lockout thirtyfold compared with an honest failed attempt.
sec04-card-sec04-R01.must_match_memory_hook: One-day miss versus thirty-day cheat ban

visual_sync.text_span: One-day miss versus thirty-day cheat ban

sec04-card-sec04-R04.question_text: What paperwork must you bring back to the center whenever you return to retake a failed exam?
sec04-card-sec04-R04.teaching_text: Examiners recheck your full folder on every return visit, so leaving original proofs at home cancels your retake.
sec04-card-sec04-R04.must_match_memory_hook: Bring every required original document again

visual_sync.text_span: Bring every required original document again

sec04-card-sec04-R06.question_text: Which three kinds of actions during an exam are treated as cheating?
sec04-card-sec04-R06.teaching_text: Writing crib notes on sleeves, speaking or checking a phone mid-test, or sending a stand-in triggers the thirty-day cheating ban.
sec04-card-sec04-R06.must_match_memory_hook: Hidden notes, talking, or test stand-ins

visual_sync.text_span: Hidden notes, talking, or test stand-ins

sec04-card-sec04-R07.question_text: Which personal communication devices must be switched completely off during both the written and road tests?
sec04-card-sec04-R07.teaching_text: Even a buzzing phone in your pocket during the written kiosk or road drive risks immediate test termination.
sec04-card-sec04-R07.must_match_memory_hook: Switch off phones, pagers, messaging devices

visual_sync.text_span: Switch off phones, pagers, messaging devices

sec04-card-sec04-F27.question_text: By what two methods can you schedule a road test, and how many days ahead does booking open?
sec04-card-sec04-F27.teaching_text: Booking online or calling toll-free up to forty-five days early locks in your slot right when permit time finishes.
sec04-card-sec04-F27.must_match_memory_hook: Online or toll-free, forty-five days ahead

visual_sync.text_span: Online or toll-free, forty-five days ahead

sec04-card-sec04-F28.question_text: What happens to your road test appointment if you have not already passed the written knowledge test?
sec04-card-sec04-F28.teaching_text: Booking a road slot hoping to pass the written test afterward backfires because unpassed knowledge status cancels the appointment.
sec04-card-sec04-F28.must_match_memory_hook: Pass knowledge first or appointment cancels

visual_sync.text_span: Pass knowledge first or appointment cancels

sec04-card-sec04-R08.question_text: What status document must an applicant without a valid Tennessee learner permit bring to the road test?
sec04-card-sec04-R08.teaching_text: Applicants testing without a prior Tennessee permit have not cleared counter status checks yet and must bring legal-presence proof.
sec04-card-sec04-R08.must_match_memory_hook: Bring citizenship, residency, or legal-stay proof

visual_sync.text_span: Bring citizenship, residency, or legal-stay proof

sec04-card-sec04-F17.question_text: How much English proficiency must an applicant have when taking the behind-the-wheel road test?
sec04-card-sec04-F17.teaching_text: Because interpreters cannot ride along, safe road testing requires understanding spoken turn and lane instructions in real time.
sec04-card-sec04-F17.must_match_memory_hook: Enough English to understand examiner directions

visual_sync.text_span: Enough English to understand examiner directions

sec04-card-sec04-F29.question_text: At least how many minutes before your scheduled road test should you arrive, and why?
sec04-card-sec04-F29.teaching_text: Checking in fifteen minutes ahead leaves room to verify documents and inspect the car before your drive clock starts.
sec04-card-sec04-F29.must_match_memory_hook: Arrive fifteen minutes early for paperwork

visual_sync.text_span: Arrive fifteen minutes early for paperwork

sec04-card-sec04-F19.question_text: What happens if you check in more than five minutes past your scheduled road test time?
sec04-card-sec04-F19.teaching_text: Tight back-to-back examiner schedules mean showing up past the five-minute mark forces you to rebook for another day.
sec04-card-sec04-F19.must_match_memory_hook: Over five minutes late cancels test

visual_sync.text_span: Over five minutes late cancels test

sec04-card-sec04-F36.question_text: How many minutes does a Tennessee road test average, and when does lateness force rescheduling?
sec04-card-sec04-F36.teaching_text: Because each drive slot runs twenty to twenty-five minutes, arriving five or more minutes late throws off the whole queue.

sec04-card-sec04-F04.question_text: Which severe weather conditions and winter time-of-day rule halt Tennessee road tests?
sec04-card-sec04-F04.teaching_text: Heavy downpours, dense fog, hail, high winds, ice, or winter darkness make public-street testing unsafe for applicants and examiners.
sec04-card-sec04-F04.must_match_memory_hook: No extreme storms or winter darkness

visual_sync.text_span: No extreme storms or winter darkness

sec04-card-sec04-F20.question_text: Which mild weather lets road tests proceed versus which severe conditions shut them down?
sec04-card-sec04-F20.teaching_text: Light drizzle or mild snow stays testable, whereas thunderstorms, thick fog, flooded streets, packed ice, or warnings cancel drives.
sec04-card-sec04-F20.must_match_memory_hook: Light precipitation proceeds; storms, floods cancel

visual_sync.text_span: Light precipitation proceeds; storms, floods cancel

sec04-card-sec04-R11.question_text: Under what two broad situations may the Department cancel scheduled road test appointments?
sec04-card-sec04-R11.teaching_text: Public safety overrides appointment times whenever local emergencies or hazardous weather hit a testing area.
sec04-card-sec04-R11.must_match_memory_hook: Emergencies or dangerous weather cancel slots

visual_sync.text_span: Emergencies or dangerous weather cancel slots

sec04-card-sec04-F32.question_text: Who is allowed inside the car during a road test, are pets allowed, and will examiners ever ask for illegal moves?
sec04-card-sec04-F32.teaching_text: Parents and pets wait inside the building, and examiners test straightforward legal driving rather than tricking you into violations.
sec04-card-sec04-F32.must_match_memory_hook: Applicant and examiner only, zero tricks

visual_sync.text_span: Applicant and examiner only, zero tricks

sec04-card-sec04-F18.question_text: Does the state provide a road-test car, or what must the applicant bring?
sec04-card-sec04-F18.teaching_text: Testing centers never lend cars, and broken safety or operating gear stops the exam during pre-drive inspection.
sec04-card-sec04-F18.must_match_memory_hook: Supply your own fully working vehicle

visual_sync.text_span: Supply your own fully working vehicle

sec04-card-sec04-F21.question_text: Starting with which model year must a passenger test car have working seat belts for both you and the examiner?
sec04-card-sec04-F21.teaching_text: A jammed or frayed passenger belt in any nineteen-sixty-nine-or-newer vehicle cancels the road test at the curb.
sec04-card-sec04-F21.must_match_memory_hook: Nineteen sixty-nine and newer, both seats

visual_sync.text_span: Nineteen sixty-nine and newer, both seats

sec04-card-sec04-F22.question_text: Which two separate braking systems must every car have by Tennessee law?
sec04-card-sec04-F22.teaching_text: If hydraulic foot brakes fail, a working independent parking brake gives you and the examiner emergency stopping power.
sec04-card-sec04-F22.must_match_memory_hook: Regular foot brake plus parking brake

visual_sync.text_span: Regular foot brake plus parking brake

sec04-card-sec04-F23.question_text: What minimum and maximum number of white headlights may a motor vehicle carry?
sec04-card-sec04-F23.teaching_text: Driving to your road test with one burned-out headlight or illegal extra forward lamps fails the equipment check.
sec04-card-sec04-F23.must_match_memory_hook: Two minimum, four maximum white headlights

visual_sync.text_span: Two minimum, four maximum white headlights

sec04-card-sec04-F24.question_text: Which five rear lights must work on a passenger car brought for testing?
sec04-card-sec04-F24.teaching_text: Examiners walk behind the car before starting, and a single dead brake light, tail light, or plate light halts testing.
sec04-card-sec04-F24.must_match_memory_hook: Plate light, two tails, two brakes

visual_sync.text_span: Plate light, two tails, two brakes

sec04-card-sec04-F25.question_text: How many windshield wipers should a vehicle have, and when is a single wiper acceptable?
sec04-card-sec04-F25.teaching_text: A mono-wiper design passes only when that single blade clears within one inch of the inside windshield edge.
sec04-card-sec04-F25.must_match_memory_hook: Two wipers unless one sweeps full

visual_sync.text_span: Two wipers unless one sweeps full

sec04-card-sec04-F26.question_text: What mirror must every test vehicle have, and when are two outside mirrors also required?
sec04-card-sec04-F26.teaching_text: Every car needs a clear rearview mirror, and certain vision or hearing restrictions mandate left and right outside mirrors.
sec04-card-sec04-F26.must_match_memory_hook: Unblocked rearview; two outside for impairments

visual_sync.text_span: Unblocked rearview; two outside for impairments

sec04-card-sec04-R10.question_text: Beyond lights and brakes, what audible warning device and registration item must work and be current on your test car?
sec04-card-sec04-R10.teaching_text: Expired license plate stickers or a dead horn end a road test right in the parking lot before moving an inch.
sec04-card-sec04-R10.must_match_memory_hook: Working horn and current registration tags

visual_sync.text_span: Working horn and current registration tags

sec04-card-sec04-R13.question_text: What exhaust, dashboard, and front-door rules must your road-test car pass before driving?
sec04-card-sec04-R13.teaching_text: Examiners will not climb into a car with broken door handles, heavy exhaust smoke, or a dead speedometer.
sec04-card-sec04-R13.must_match_memory_hook: Quiet muffler, working speedometer, two-way doors

visual_sync.text_span: Quiet muffler, working speedometer, two-way doors

sec04-card-sec04-F30.question_text: What window-tint limit applies to a passenger car's windshield and side or rear windows?
sec04-card-sec04-F30.teaching_text: Aftermarket windshield film or dark passenger-car tint letting under thirty-five percent of visible light through fails inspection.
sec04-card-sec04-F30.must_match_memory_hook: Zero windshield tint, thirty-five percent windows

visual_sync.text_span: Zero windshield tint, thirty-five percent windows

sec04-card-sec04-R12.question_text: On a sport-utility or multi-purpose vehicle, which windows skip tint limits and which still follow the passenger-car rule?
sec04-card-sec04-R12.teaching_text: Factory privacy glass behind the front row is legal on multi-purpose vehicles, while front left and right windows keep the thirty-five-percent rule.
sec04-card-sec04-R12.must_match_memory_hook: Rear windows exempt; front sides regulated

visual_sync.text_span: Rear windows exempt; front sides regulated

sec04-card-sec04-F31.question_text: Between what ground heights must bumpers sit on a passenger car versus a four-by-four recreational vehicle?
sec04-card-sec04-F31.teaching_text: Extreme lift or drop kits that push bumpers outside fourteen-to-twenty-two or fourteen-to-thirty-one inches fail safety rules.

sec04-card-sec04-R09.question_text: How many vehicle controls must you demonstrate before driving off, including which glass-clearing control?
sec04-card-sec04-R09.teaching_text: Fumbling for your defroster fan, hazard flashers, or wipers in an unfamiliar car starts the test off rattled.
sec04-card-sec04-R09.must_match_memory_hook: Demonstrate eight controls including windshield defroster

visual_sync.text_span: Demonstrate eight controls including windshield defroster

sec04-card-sec04-R16.question_text: Why should you bring a familiar car to the road test, and which six systems plus registration must be ready?
sec04-card-sec04-R16.teaching_text: Testing in the car you practiced in with current tags and working horn, lights, belts, brakes, signals, and wipers keeps nerves steady.
sec04-card-sec04-R16.must_match_memory_hook: Familiar car with working safety systems

visual_sync.text_span: Familiar car with working safety systems

sec04-card-sec04-R14.question_text: Which core driving habits—from starting and backing to intersections, spacing, and signaling—does the road examiner grade?
sec04-card-sec04-R14.teaching_text: Smooth starts, mirror checks, full stops, safe following gaps, crisp turns, and speed adjustments all count on the score sheet.
sec04-card-sec04-R14.must_match_memory_hook: Every control, turn, stop, and signal

visual_sync.text_span: Every control, turn, stop, and signal

sec04-card-sec04-F33.question_text: Which four actions end a Tennessee road test in immediate failure regardless of error count?
sec04-card-sec04-F33.teaching_text: Rolling a stop sign, ignoring instructions, pulling a dangerous move, or contributing to a wreck ends the drive immediately.
sec04-card-sec04-F33.must_match_memory_hook: Law violation, refusal, danger, or crash

visual_sync.text_span: Law violation, refusal, danger, or crash

sec04-card-sec04-F34.question_text: How many road-test errors still pass, and what retest waits apply at seven-to-nine, ten-to-twelve, and thirteen-to-fifteen errors?
sec04-card-sec04-F34.teaching_text: One through six errors earns a pass, while higher brackets step retest waits from one day to seven and fourteen days.
sec04-card-sec04-F34.must_match_memory_hook: Up to six passes; waits climb

visual_sync.text_span: Up to six passes; waits climb

sec04-card-sec04-F35.question_text: How long must you practice before retesting after sixteen or more road-test errors or an automatic failure?
sec04-card-sec04-F35.teaching_text: Sixteen-plus errors or an automatic fail signals major skill gaps requiring a full thirty-day practice window before returning.

sec04-card-sec04-R15.question_text: What feedback does the examiner give you right after a failed road test?
sec04-card-sec04-R15.teaching_text: Listening closely to the examiner's breakdown tells you the exact habits and maneuvers to sharpen before your next appointment.
sec04-card-sec04-R15.must_match_memory_hook: Explains mistakes, fixes, and practice maneuvers

visual_sync.text_span: Explains mistakes, fixes, and practice maneuvers

sec12-card-sec12-F01.question_text: Under Tennessee law, at least what percentage of knowledge-test questions must cover impaired driving?
sec12-card-sec12-F01.teaching_text: Dedicating one-fourth of every written exam to alcohol and drugs guarantees applicants know DUI consequences cold.

sec12-card-sec12-F02.question_text: Between ten at night and two in the morning, roughly what fraction of drivers are intoxicated?
sec12-card-sec12-F02.teaching_text: Knowing ten percent of late-night cars around you may be impaired keeps your defensive spacing wide.

sec12-card-sec12-F03.question_text: What type of drinkers account for nearly half of all DUI arrests?
sec12-card-sec12-F03.teaching_text: Assuming only chronic heavy drinkers catch DUIs blinds social drinkers to how fast two drinks impair.

sec12-card-sec12-R01.question_text: Where had more than one-third of late-night intoxicated drivers been drinking beforehand?
sec12-card-sec12-R01.teaching_text: Private house gatherings pour unmeasured drinks without bartenders, sending impaired guests onto dark streets.

sec12-card-sec12-F04.question_text: How soon after swallowing a drink does alcohol begin entering your bloodstream?
sec12-card-sec12-F04.teaching_text: Unlike solid food needing full digestion, alcohol passes directly through stomach walls almost immediately.

sec12-card-sec12-F05.question_text: How does drinking faster than your liver can oxidize alcohol affect blood concentration and intoxication?
sec12-card-sec12-F05.teaching_text: Unprocessed alcohol piles up in circulating blood and reaches the brain faster with every extra drink.

sec12-card-sec12-F06.question_text: Roughly how fast does the liver oxidize alcohol, and do coffee, showers, or exercise help?
sec12-card-sec12-F06.teaching_text: Hot coffee or cold water leaves circulating blood alcohol untouched while creating false alertness.

sec12-card-sec12-R03.question_text: Roughly what share of alcohol does the liver break down, and how does liver disease change BAC?
sec12-card-sec12-R03.teaching_text: Because lungs, kidneys, and sweat clear almost nothing, liver damage traps high BAC much longer.

sec12-card-sec12-R04.question_text: What health damage can chronic heavy drinking inflict across organs and specifically on the liver?
sec12-card-sec12-R04.teaching_text: Years of heavy alcohol exposure scar liver tissue permanently while damaging nearly every major organ.

sec12-card-sec12-F07.question_text: What does blood alcohol concentration measure, and what does a higher number mean?
sec12-card-sec12-F07.teaching_text: Objective blood-percentage numbers expose rising impairment even when a drinker insists they feel fine.

sec12-card-sec12-F08.question_text: Which BAC level is always illegal in Tennessee, and how many drops per ten thousand is it?
sec12-card-sec12-F08.teaching_text: Visualizing eight drops of alcohol per ten thousand drops of blood shows how little triggers DUI.

sec12-card-sec12-F09.question_text: Which three primary variables govern how high your BAC climbs?
sec12-card-sec12-F09.teaching_text: Tracking how much you drink against your weight and clock hours explains why rapid rounds spike BAC.

sec12-card-sec12-F10.question_text: Does body weight or drink category stop each drink within an hour from pushing BAC upward?
sec12-card-sec12-F10.teaching_text: Big body size or choosing light beer never stops back-to-back drinks from climbing upward.

sec12-card-sec12-F11.question_text: How do three drinks finished inside one hour compare with three drinks spaced across three hours?
sec12-card-sec12-F11.teaching_text: Cramming three drinks into sixty minutes overwhelms your liver's one-drink-per-hour clearance rate.

sec12-card-sec12-F12.question_text: Between two drinkers of identical scale weight, why does the one with higher body fat show intoxication sooner?
sec12-card-sec12-F12.teaching_text: Because fat tissue holds very little water, alcohol concentrates more densely inside the remaining body water.

sec12-card-sec12-R02.question_text: What happens when a smaller-framed person matches drink-for-drink with larger friends?
sec12-card-sec12-R02.teaching_text: Less total body water concentrates identical rounds faster, dropping inhibitions and judgment well ahead of larger peers.

sec12-card-sec12-F13.question_text: How does eating beforehand affect alcohol absorption, and does food block alcohol from reaching your blood?
sec12-card-sec12-F13.teaching_text: A heavy meal delays peak timing slightly, yet every drop consumed still enters your bloodstream.

sec12-card-sec12-F42.question_text: How does the alcohol inside a twelve-ounce beer compare with a one-ounce shot of whiskey?
sec12-card-sec12-F42.teaching_text: Ordering beer instead of liquor shots puts roughly the same pure ethanol into your bloodstream.

sec12-card-sec12-F43.question_text: Roughly how much time is needed to clear one drink versus three drinks?
sec12-card-sec12-F43.teaching_text: Budgeting at least one full hour per standard drink prevents misjudging lingering blood alcohol.

sec12-card-sec12-R35.question_text: According to reliable studies, how many drinks within three hours impair driving for most people?
sec12-card-sec12-R35.teaching_text: Even moderate social consumption inside a three-hour dinner degrades reaction and tracking for most motorists.

sec12-card-sec12-F14.question_text: Compared with sober driving, how many times likelier is causing a crash at point one zero, point one five, and point one seven BAC?
sec12-card-sec12-F14.teaching_text: Crash odds explode exponentially rather than rising gently once blood alcohol climbs past the legal limit.

sec12-card-sec12-F15.question_text: How low can BAC be when skill, judgment, and vision already suffer greatly, especially in young drinkers?
sec12-card-sec12-F15.teaching_text: Treating zero point zero eight as a safe target ignores major skill loss starting around half that level.

sec12-card-sec12-R05.question_text: What estimated share of Americans will be involved in an alcohol-related crash during their lifetime?
sec12-card-sec12-R05.teaching_text: Even lifelong non-drinkers share roads where forty percent of the public eventually encounters impaired crashes.

sec12-card-sec12-F16.question_text: Which two abilities matter most for safe driving, and how much alcohol does it take to hurt both?
sec12-card-sec12-F16.teaching_text: Safe driving rests on seeing hazards clearly and choosing wise responses, both dulled by small doses.

sec12-card-sec12-F17.question_text: After how many drinks does your ability to judge speed, time, and distance begin changing?
sec12-card-sec12-F17.teaching_text: Misjudging oncoming closing speed by one second turns a routine left turn into a collision.

sec12-card-sec12-F18.question_text: Which four reckless behind-the-wheel behaviors commonly reveal alcohol-impaired judgment?
sec12-card-sec12-F18.teaching_text: Lowered inhibitions push impaired drivers into aggressive stunts and blind passes they would soberly skip.

sec12-card-sec12-F19.question_text: How severely does alcohol cut clear night vision and affect headlight-glare recovery?
sec12-card-sec12-F19.teaching_text: Losing over half your night clarity while staying dazzled longer makes dark rural highways treacherous.

sec12-card-sec12-R06.question_text: What does alcohol do to your eye muscles that degrades focusing and glare vision?
sec12-card-sec12-R06.teaching_text: Sluggish eye muscles cannot snap cleanly from dashboard gauges to distant taillights or oncoming beams.

sec12-card-sec12-R07.question_text: Why does alcohol ruin depth and distance judgment and raise head-on and rear-end crash risk?
sec12-card-sec12-R07.teaching_text: When both eyes stop syncing one crisp stereo picture, judging gaps to cars ahead breaks down.

sec12-card-sec12-R08.question_text: Almost what percentage of all driving information reaches you through your eyes?
sec12-card-sec12-R08.teaching_text: Because nine-tenths of driving cues are visual, even slight alcohol blur ripples into every maneuver.

sec12-card-sec12-F20.question_text: By roughly what percentage does peripheral side vision shrink at point zero five BAC?
sec12-card-sec12-F20.teaching_text: Narrowed tunnel vision misses cross-street cars, cyclists, and kids stepping off curbs beside you.

sec12-card-sec12-F21.question_text: At how low a BAC do reaction time and physical coordination begin suffering?
sec12-card-sec12-F21.teaching_text: Measurable hand-foot lag appears after barely one drink, long before reaching adult legal cutoffs.

sec12-card-sec12-R09.question_text: What happens simultaneously to alertness, concentration, reactions, and coordination as drinking continues?
sec12-card-sec12-R09.teaching_text: Spotting hazards later while steering and braking clumsier creates a fatal compounding spiral.

sec12-card-sec12-R34.question_text: Which mental faculty is the very first thing alcohol impairs upon reaching the brain?
sec12-card-sec12-R34.teaching_text: Because self-criticism fails first, drinkers lose the very judgment needed to realize they should not drive.

sec12-card-sec12-F22.question_text: Is alcohol chemically a stimulant or a depressant, and why do small doses feel lively?
sec12-card-sec12-F22.teaching_text: Loosened social restraint mimics excitement briefly while the central nervous system actually slows down.

sec12-card-sec12-R11.question_text: How does alcohol affect nerve impulses and body functions needed for focused driving?
sec12-card-sec12-R11.teaching_text: Depressed nerve signaling makes holding sustained highway attention and crisp muscle timing far harder.

sec12-card-sec12-F23.question_text: What happens when alcohol mixes with another depressant like a tranquilizer or sedative?
sec12-card-sec12-F23.teaching_text: One pill plus one drink hits far harder than two drinks because depressant sedating power multiplies.

sec12-card-sec12-F24.question_text: Does holding a valid doctor's prescription legally excuse driving under that drug's influence?
sec12-card-sec12-F24.teaching_text: Courtroom DUI guilt hinges on impaired driving control, never on whether a medicine was legally prescribed.

sec12-card-sec12-R12.question_text: What question should you always ask when a doctor prescribes a sedative or tranquilizer?
sec12-card-sec12-R12.teaching_text: Clarifying sedation windows in the exam room prevents discovering heavy drowsiness mid-commute.

sec12-card-sec12-F25.question_text: Which three impairing ingredients can hide inside over-the-counter cold, cough, and allergy remedies?
sec12-card-sec12-F25.teaching_text: Store-shelf cold syrups and allergy tablets often pack sedating compounds that demand reading labels first.

sec12-card-sec12-R13.question_text: Which two classic bottle warnings flag driving risk, and whom should you ask when unsure?
sec12-card-sec12-R13.teaching_text: Your family car is the heaviest fast-moving machinery most people ever operate.

sec12-card-sec12-R14.question_text: Which two essential driving faculties do studies show marijuana and other drugs impair?
sec12-card-sec12-R14.teaching_text: Distorted decision-making paired with clumsier steering and braking makes drug-impaired driving hazardous.

sec12-card-sec12-R37.question_text: How can cold remedies fool sick drivers, and what happens if antihistamines mix with alcohol?
sec12-card-sec12-R37.teaching_text: Clearing a stuffy head makes you feel better while antihistamines quietly dull vision, reflexes, and alcohol tolerance.

sec12-card-sec12-F26.question_text: Where beyond public roads, and under what states of control or drug influence, does Tennessee DUI law apply?
sec12-card-sec12-F26.teaching_text: Sitting in physical control inside a shopping-center or apartment parking lot still triggers full DUI arrest.

sec12-card-sec12-F27.question_text: At what blood or breath alcohol percentage is driving or physical control automatically illegal in Tennessee?
sec12-card-sec12-F27.teaching_text: Once chemical testing hits eight-hundredths percent, prosecutors need no extra roadside stumble to prove violation.

sec12-card-sec12-F28.question_text: Can you still be convicted of DUI below point zero eight, or even at point zero zero BAC?
sec12-card-sec12-F28.teaching_text: Blowing triple zeros on an alcohol breathalyzer never clears a driver impaired by pills or cannabis.

sec12-card-sec12-R10.question_text: Which three driver groups face stricter legal alcohol cutoffs below the standard point zero eight?
sec12-card-sec12-R10.teaching_text: Underage drivers, CDL holders, and prior DUI offenders trigger violations at lower blood-alcohol readings.

sec12-card-sec12-R15.question_text: What speed or lane behaviors give police legal grounds to pull you over for a DUI check?
sec12-card-sec12-R15.teaching_text: Driving suspiciously slow to look careful draws blue lights just as quickly as speeding or weaving.

sec12-card-sec12-F29.question_text: What agreement do you automatically make under Tennessee's Implied Consent Law whenever you drive?
sec12-card-sec12-F29.teaching_text: Using Tennessee roads carries built-in consent to chemical testing whenever an officer has reasonable grounds.

sec12-card-sec12-F30.question_text: How long will a court likely suspend your driving privileges if you refuse testing after arrest?
sec12-card-sec12-F30.teaching_text: Saying no to chemical testing costs a full year of driving privileges separate from DUI trial outcomes.

sec12-card-sec12-F31.question_text: What authority does Tennessee's No Refusal law give police investigating suspected impaired drivers?
sec12-card-sec12-F31.teaching_text: Refusing a breath test no longer blocks chemical evidence when judges issue electronic blood warrants.

sec12-card-sec12-F32.question_text: How do Tennessee DUI penalties for prescription, OTC, or illegal drugs compare with alcohol DUI?
sec12-card-sec12-F32.teaching_text: Impairment carries the exact same jail, fines, and revocations regardless of whether alcohol or pills caused it.

sec12-card-sec12-F33.question_text: What roadside probation duty and vest message apply to every Tennessee DUI conviction?
sec12-card-sec12-F33.teaching_text: Twenty-four hours of roadside litter pickup in marked attire is a mandatory probation condition.

sec12-card-sec12-R16.question_text: How must the state mark a photo ID issued to someone whose license is revoked for DUI?
sec12-card-sec12-R16.teaching_text: Replacing a revoked driver license with a state ID still displays DUI-offender status on the card.

sec12-card-sec12-R17.question_text: In which county does a Tennessee resident complete mandatory DUI litter-pickup shifts?
sec12-card-sec12-R17.teaching_text: Serving roadside litter shifts locally ensures community accountability right where the resident lives.

sec12-card-sec12-F34.question_text: What mandatory jail and fine minimums are added on top of DUI penalties with a passenger under eighteen?
sec12-card-sec12-F34.teaching_text: Endangering a minor in the cabin stacks mandatory extra jail time and a four-figure fine.

sec12-card-sec12-R19.question_text: Which felony grades apply when a DUI seriously injures versus kills an accompanying child?
sec12-card-sec12-R19.teaching_text: Harming a young passenger elevates impaired driving immediately into severe multi-year felony prosecution.

sec12-card-sec12-F35.question_text: Which criminal charges can follow an impaired crash that kills someone versus injures someone?
sec12-card-sec12-F35.teaching_text: Causing bloodshed while impaired turns a traffic stop into high-grade violent felony prosecution.

sec12-card-sec12-F36.question_text: After how many DUI convictions within what timeframe will Tennessee seize the offender's vehicle?
sec12-card-sec12-F36.teaching_text: Picking up a second DUI inside five years forfeits the vehicle itself to state seizure.

sec12-card-sec12-R18.question_text: What can happen to the car if someone already revoked for DUI gets caught driving on that revoked license?
sec12-card-sec12-R18.teaching_text: Getting caught behind the wheel during an active DUI revocation puts the vehicle up for forfeiture.

sec12-card-sec12-F37.question_text: How long after reinstatement must someone with two DUIs in five years use an ignition interlock?
sec12-card-sec12-F37.teaching_text: Breath-locked ignition hardware blocks engine startup whenever alcohol registers on the returning driver's breath.

sec12-card-sec12-R20.question_text: When must a judge order a formal drug-and-alcohol treatment assessment for a DUI offender?
sec12-card-sec12-R20.teaching_text: Repeat impairment within five years triggers mandatory clinical screening and court-enforced treatment.

sec12-card-sec12-R21.question_text: Which three additional obligations can a court impose alongside standard DUI jail and fines?
sec12-card-sec12-R21.teaching_text: Judges combine safety education, repeat-offender rehab, and financial payback to injured crash victims.

sec12-card-sec12-R22.question_text: Which out-of-pocket expenses push the real price of a DUI into several thousand dollars?
sec12-card-sec12-R22.teaching_text: Bail bonds, defense counsel, missed shifts, treatment bills, and high-risk insurance dwarf courtroom fines.

sec12-card-sec12-R23.question_text: What jail time, high-BAC jail boost, fine range, and revocation apply to a first DUI conviction?
sec12-card-sec12-R23.teaching_text: Even a first conviction brings mandatory jail—jumping to seven days at point two zero—plus yearlong revocation.

sec12-card-sec12-R24.question_text: What jail span, fine range, and license revocation apply to a second DUI conviction?
sec12-card-sec12-R24.teaching_text: A second conviction jumps to at least forty-five days locked up and up to thirty-five hundred in fines.

sec12-card-sec12-R25.question_text: How does Tennessee's DUI penalty table classify a fourth or subsequent DUI conviction?
sec12-card-sec12-R25.teaching_text: Reaching a fourth conviction crosses permanently from misdemeanor court into Class E felony status.

sec12-card-sec12-R26.question_text: What is the leading cause of death among young people, and what share involves alcohol?
sec12-card-sec12-R26.teaching_text: Motor-vehicle wrecks claim more young lives than any other cause, fueled heavily by drinking.

sec12-card-sec12-R27.question_text: How high must BAC climb before most teenagers become intoxicated?
sec12-card-sec12-R27.teaching_text: Unfamiliarity with alcohol causes heavy coordination and judgment loss in teens at very low readings.

sec12-card-sec12-F41.question_text: Why do young drivers face far higher crash odds than older drivers between point zero one and point zero eight?
sec12-card-sec12-F41.teaching_text: New drivers still learning hazard scanning cannot absorb alcohol's distraction on top of inexperience.

sec12-card-sec12-F38.question_text: What license loss hits an eighteen-to-twenty-year-old for buying or possessing alcohol, even away from any car?
sec12-card-sec12-F38.teaching_text: You do not have to be near a vehicle for underage alcohol possession to revoke driving privileges.

sec12-card-sec12-F39.question_text: How long do thirteen-to-seventeen-year-olds lose driving rights for first-offense alcohol or drug possession?
sec12-card-sec12-F39.teaching_text: Whichever period runs longer applies even to young teens who have not yet earned a learner permit.

sec12-card-sec12-R28.question_text: For ages thirteen through seventeen, how long is the suspension on a second substance conviction?
sec12-card-sec12-R28.teaching_text: A repeat juvenile substance offense locks out driving privileges for at least two full years or adulthood.

sec12-card-sec12-F40.question_text: At what BAC do sixteen-to-twenty-year-old drivers commit underage driving while impaired, and what penalties apply?
sec12-card-sec12-F40.teaching_text: Blowing just point zero two under twenty-one costs one year of driving plus a two-hundred-fifty-dollar fine.

sec12-card-sec12-R29.question_text: What extra requirement can courts add to license loss and fines for underage driving while impaired?
sec12-card-sec12-R29.teaching_text: Judges routinely attach community service hours onto the mandatory fine and one-year suspension.

sec12-card-sec12-R30.question_text: How does the designated-driver plan work, and how do many venues support that friend?
sec12-card-sec12-R30.teaching_text: Picking a completely abstinent driver before going out keeps everyone safe and often earns free soft drinks.

sec12-card-sec12-R31.question_text: Why must you decide not to drive before taking your very first drink?
sec12-card-sec12-R31.teaching_text: Waiting until after two drinks hands a life-or-death choice to a brain whose judgment already dropped.

sec12-card-sec12-R32.question_text: Which three practical group habits keep drinkers off the driver's seat?
sec12-card-sec12-R32.teaching_text: Giving your car keys to a sober friend before drinking removes any late-night impulse to drive home.

sec12-card-sec12-R33.question_text: What simple response works best when someone offers you alcohol and you are driving?
sec12-card-sec12-R33.teaching_text: Stating plainly that you are driving tonight ends peer pressure cleanly while protecting your passengers.

sec12-card-sec12-R36.question_text: Which preventable hazard causes more deaths below age forty than any other cause?
sec12-card-sec12-R36.teaching_text: Impaired crashes outrank diseases and other hazards as the top cause of death below forty.

sec12-card-sec12-R38.question_text: In the manual's two-thousand-twenty Tennessee data, what share of traffic deaths involved alcohol and also drugs?
sec12-card-sec12-R38.teaching_text: More than a quarter of state traffic deaths involved alcohol, with over a third of those mixing drugs.

sec12-card-sec12-R39.question_text: For two thousand twenty-one, what approximate shares of fatalities involved alcohol versus drugs or alcohol?
sec12-card-sec12-R39.teaching_text: Roughly two out of every five traffic fatalities involved a driver impaired by alcohol, drugs, or both.

sec12-card-sec12-R40.question_text: Nationwide in two thousand twenty, roughly what percentage of all US traffic deaths were alcohol-related?
sec12-card-sec12-R40.teaching_text: Well over eleven thousand lives lost in a single year underscores why every state enforces strict DUI laws.

sec12-card-sec12-R41.question_text: Which addiction-services hotline listed in the manual offers toll-free alcohol and drug referrals?
sec12-card-sec12-R41.teaching_text: Confidential statewide helpline referrals connect drivers and families with substance help before tragedy strikes.

sec12-card-sec12-R42.question_text: Why shouldn't you memorize only the chapter's end-of-section sample questions for your written knowledge exam?
sec12-card-sec12-R42.teaching_text: Mastering the underlying handbook rules prepares you for any wording on your state permit knowledge exam.

sec13-card-sec13-R01.question_text: Which drivers are recorded inside the National Driver Register?
sec13-card-sec13-R01.teaching_text: Every state checks this nationwide index to stop suspended or high-risk drivers from getting fresh licenses elsewhere.

sec13-card-sec13-F01.question_text: Which pointer system does Tennessee run against all fifty-one US jurisdictions before issuing a license?
sec13-card-sec13-F01.teaching_text: Automated fifty-one-jurisdiction screening flags active holds from every state plus DC before printing any card.

sec13-card-sec13-F02.question_text: Can Tennessee issue or renew your license while another state still reports an unresolved problem?
sec13-card-sec13-F02.teaching_text: Even routine Tennessee renewals stay frozen until the reporting state marks your record cleared.

sec13-card-sec13-F03.question_text: What limited info can Tennessee examiners give you about another state's hold, and whom must you call?
sec13-card-sec13-F03.teaching_text: Tennessee workstations see only the pointer flag and contact number rather than out-of-state case files.

sec13-card-sec13-F04.question_text: Can both a DUI conviction and refusing an implied-consent blood-alcohol test cost you your Tennessee license?
sec13-card-sec13-F04.teaching_text: Saying no to chemical testing triggers license loss under implied consent even without a DUI conviction.

sec13-card-sec13-F05.question_text: What happens to your driving privilege if you lend your license out or fraudulently alter one?
sec13-card-sec13-F05.teaching_text: Letting a friend borrow your ID or changing a birth date brings license loss straight back to you.

sec13-card-sec13-F06.question_text: What license consequence follows leaving a crash with injuries or death, or failing to stop and render aid?
sec13-card-sec13-F06.teaching_text: Driving off when someone is hurt turns an accident scene into severe criminal and licensing forfeiture.

sec13-card-sec13-F07.question_text: How many reckless-driving violations in twelve months—or what street-racing offense—can trigger suspension or revocation?
sec13-card-sec13-F07.teaching_text: A single street race or a second reckless ticket inside twelve months pulls you off the road.

sec13-card-sec13-F08.question_text: What can happen to your driver license if you drive away from a gas station without paying?
sec13-card-sec13-F08.teaching_text: Tennessee explicitly links gasoline theft at the pump to losing your legal driving privilege.

sec13-card-sec13-F09.question_text: During which two roadside encounters can lacking active coverage proof trigger a Tennessee suspension?
sec13-card-sec13-F09.teaching_text: Any crash investigation or moving-violation stop triggers mandatory verification of active financial coverage.

sec13-card-sec13-R02.question_text: Which health conditions that interfere with safe control can result in suspension or revocation?
sec13-card-sec13-R02.teaching_text: Conditions like seizures, blackouts, or Alzheimer's require medical review so sudden episodes do not cause wrecks.

sec13-card-sec13-R03.question_text: What license penalty applies to perjury or giving false ownership, use, or license-application facts?
sec13-card-sec13-R03.teaching_text: Signing untrue statements on vehicle paperwork or license forms invalidates your driving credential.

sec13-card-sec13-R04.question_text: Which three serious criminal offenses behind the wheel are automatic grounds for revocation or suspension?
sec13-card-sec13-R04.teaching_text: Using a motor vehicle in a felony, running from police, or causing fatal harm strips driving rights.

sec13-card-sec13-R05.question_text: What happens to habitual moving-violation offenders or drivers who ignore court crash-damage judgments?
sec13-card-sec13-R05.teaching_text: Piling up citations or refusing court-ordered crash compensation removes you from Tennessee roads.

sec13-card-sec13-R06.question_text: Which two non-driving legal violations can still cost you your Tennessee driver license?
sec13-card-sec13-R06.teaching_text: State law ties license retention to both underage alcohol compliance and court-ordered child support.

sec13-card-sec13-R07.question_text: Having how many grams or more of methamphetamine inside a vehicle triggers license revocation or suspension?
sec13-card-sec13-R07.teaching_text: Five grams or more inside a vehicle brings dedicated statutory license loss alongside felony drug charges.

sec13-card-sec13-F10.question_text: Must a drug or alcohol offense happen inside a car to cost a minor under eighteen driving privileges?
sec13-card-sec13-F10.teaching_text: Juvenile substance convictions anywhere strip teen driving rights even when no car keys were involved.

sec13-card-sec13-F11.question_text: Which three school-related issues can strip driving privileges from a driver younger than eighteen?
sec13-card-sec13-F11.teaching_text: Keeping a teen license in Tennessee requires staying enrolled, passing classes, and keeping weapons off campus.

sec13-card-sec13-R08.question_text: How many unexcused absences in a row—or total across a semester—count as dropping out under eighteen?
sec13-card-sec13-R08.teaching_text: Schools report unexcused attendance streaks directly to the state once ten straight or fifteen total days hit.

sec13-card-sec13-R09.question_text: How many subjects must a driver under eighteen generally pass each grading period to keep driving?
sec13-card-sec13-R09.teaching_text: Falling short of three passing grades triggers academic non-compliance suspension until grades recover.

sec13-card-sec13-F12.question_text: Within how many days must you surrender a suspended or revoked license, and what fine hits late returns?
sec13-card-sec13-F12.teaching_text: Holding onto the plastic card past twenty days tacks an extra seventy-five-dollar penalty onto reinstatement.

sec13-card-sec13-R10.question_text: Which three return options give you official credit for turning in a suspended Tennessee license?
sec13-card-sec13-R10.teaching_text: Getting your surrender logged promptly starts official credit toward serving out the suspension window.

sec13-card-sec13-F13.question_text: Except after final court convictions or judgments, what two steps precede license suspension or revocation?
sec13-card-sec13-F13.teaching_text: Administrative fairness gives drivers written notice and a chance to be heard before non-conviction suspensions start.

sec13-card-sec13-R14.question_text: After an administrative hearing, which four corrective tools might the department try before suspending you?
sec13-card-sec13-R14.teaching_text: Corrective courses, re-exams, or probationary terms aim to fix bad driving habits before pulling privileges.

sec13-card-sec13-F14.question_text: What is Tennessee's day-count deadline and three ways to file an address move?
sec13-card-sec13-F14.teaching_text: Updating online, by letter, or at a center inside ten days keeps your legal file current.

sec13-card-sec13-R11.question_text: Must you get a reprinted plastic card immediately after reporting an address move?
sec13-card-sec13-R11.teaching_text: As long as the state computer file holds your current address, the printed card updates next renewal.

sec13-card-sec13-R12.question_text: What two problems can hit you if you fail to keep a current address on file?
sec13-card-sec13-R12.teaching_text: Unforwarded suspension or renewal notices still take legal effect even if mailed to your old apartment.

sec13-card-sec13-F15.question_text: Under the Non-Resident Violator Compact, what happens if you ignore a ticket in Tennessee or a member state?
sec13-card-sec13-F15.teaching_text: Member states share unpaid citation holds so throwing away a vacation speeding ticket suspends your license.

sec13-card-sec13-F16.question_text: How long does a Non-Resident Violator Compact suspension remain active?
sec13-card-sec13-F16.teaching_text: No fixed calendar wait clears a compact hold until the issuing court verifies full settlement.

sec13-card-sec13-F17.question_text: Which two official report sources add point values onto your Department of Safety driving record?
sec13-card-sec13-F17.teaching_text: Both moving-violation convictions and officer-documented crash fault build your twelve-month point total.

sec13-card-sec13-F18.question_text: At how many points within twelve months does an adult driver aged eighteen or older face proposed suspension?
sec13-card-sec13-F18.teaching_text: Hitting twelve points inside any rolling year triggers formal proposed suspension proceedings.

sec13-card-sec13-F19.question_text: What twelve-month point total triggers a mailed advisory warning letter for an adult driver?
sec13-card-sec13-F19.teaching_text: An advisory letter warns you are halfway to suspension while there is still time to clean up.

sec13-card-sec13-F20.question_text: For a driver under eighteen, what twelve-month point counts trigger an advisory letter versus proposed suspension?
sec13-card-sec13-F20.teaching_text: Minors get half the adult cushion, so a single six-point ticket triggers proposed suspension.

sec13-card-sec13-F21.question_text: How often may you use a Defensive Driving Course to avoid or shorten a point suspension?
sec13-card-sec13-F21.teaching_text: Defensive school is a once-in-five-years lifeline rather than a repeatable ticket eraser.

sec13-card-sec13-F22.question_text: What payments and insurance filings are required to restore a license after a frequent-violation suspension?
sec13-card-sec13-F22.teaching_text: Adults returning from point suspensions must carry high-risk SR-twenty-two filings alongside paying fees.

sec13-card-sec13-R13.question_text: What determines your exact reinstatement steps, and which state office handles clearing records?
sec13-card-sec13-R13.teaching_text: Every hold on your history must satisfy the Financial Responsibility office before full privileges return.

sec13-card-sec13-F23.question_text: What two consequences hit if you get caught driving while your license is suspended?
sec13-card-sec13-F23.teaching_text: Getting pulled over while suspended stretches your time off the road and adds criminal court charges.

sec13-card-sec13-F25.question_text: How many points hit your record for passing a stopped school, church, or youth bus loading passengers?
sec13-card-sec13-F25.teaching_text: Eight points is Tennessee's top single-violation tier—more than enough alone to suspend a minor.

sec13-card-sec13-F26.question_text: How many points are assigned for failing to stop as required at a railroad crossing?
sec13-card-sec13-F26.teaching_text: Blowing past active rail crossings carries the same severe eight-point hit as passing a school bus.

sec13-card-sec13-F27.question_text: How many points do reckless driving versus careless or negligent driving add to your record?
sec13-card-sec13-F27.teaching_text: For a driver under eighteen, one six-point reckless conviction hits the suspension mark immediately.

sec13-card-sec13-F28.question_text: What point penalty hits a minor under eighteen caught using a phone behind the wheel?
sec13-card-sec13-F28.teaching_text: Because six points triggers juvenile suspension, one phone ticket under eighteen puts your license at risk.

sec13-card-sec13-F29.question_text: How many points apply for failing to yield to emergency vehicles or move over for roadside responders?
sec13-card-sec13-F29.teaching_text: Crowding sirens or failing to slow and move over for roadside crews adds six heavy points.

sec13-card-sec13-F30.question_text: How many points apply when you contribute to a crash causing property damage, bodily injury, or death?
sec13-card-sec13-F30.teaching_text: Crash points scale sharply with harm severity, climbing from three up to eight for fatalities.
sec13-card-sec13-F30.must_match_memory_hook: Damage three, injury four, death eight

visual_sync.text_span: Damage three, injury four, death eight

sec13-card-sec13-R15.question_text: How many points apply to speeding one to five miles per hour over on normal roads versus work zones?
sec13-card-sec13-R15.teaching_text: Every speeding bracket adds extra point weight inside active highway construction zones.

sec13-card-sec13-R16.question_text: How many points apply for speeding six to fifteen miles per hour over normally versus in construction zones?
sec13-card-sec13-R16.teaching_text: Going ten over through cones tacks four points onto your twelve-month tally.

sec13-card-sec13-R17.question_text: At sixteen through twenty-five over the limit, what points apply on open roads versus construction zones?
sec13-card-sec13-R17.teaching_text: Twenty over in a work zone lands five points—one shy of juvenile suspension on a single stop.

sec13-card-sec13-R18.question_text: What point totals apply at twenty-six to thirty-five, thirty-six to forty-five, and forty-six-plus over?
sec13-card-sec13-R18.teaching_text: Extreme speeding climbs straight to the top eight-point bracket alongside fleeing police.

sec13-card-sec13-R19.question_text: How many points do driving below a posted minimum speed or driving too fast for conditions each carry?
sec13-card-sec13-R19.teaching_text: Both crawling below highway minimums and outdriving rain or ice add three points.

sec13-card-sec13-R20.question_text: How many points are assigned to failing to yield right-of-way and to improper passing?
sec13-card-sec13-R20.teaching_text: Cutting off priority traffic or passing illegally each drops four points onto your record.

sec13-card-sec13-R21.question_text: Which four common tailgating, turning, backing, and blinker mistakes each carry three points?
sec13-card-sec13-R21.teaching_text: Four everyday sloppy habits—following closely, bad turns, bad backing, and no blinker—cost three points apiece.

sec13-card-sec13-R22.question_text: How many points apply to vehicular reckless endangerment, fleeing police, and child endangerment?
sec13-card-sec13-R22.teaching_text: Endangering lives or running from blue lights hits the ceiling eight-point tier immediately.

sec13-card-sec13-R23.question_text: How do points compare between driving while suspended or revoked versus simply forgetting your card at home?
sec13-card-sec13-R23.teaching_text: Leaving your wallet home is a minor two-point slip, whereas driving suspended slams eight points down.

sec13-card-sec13-R24.question_text: How many points apply for breaking printed license restrictions versus failing to report a crash?
sec13-card-sec13-R24.teaching_text: Driving without required glasses or outside GDL curfews adds six points—enough to suspend a teen.

sec13-card-sec13-F24.question_text: What limited driving does a restricted license permit during a suspension or revocation?
sec13-card-sec13-F24.teaching_text: Deviating off the exact routes or purposes printed on a restricted card counts as driving suspended.

sec13-card-sec13-F31.question_text: Which prior convictions bar a driver from ever receiving a DUI restricted license?
sec13-card-sec13-F31.teaching_text: Prior impaired offenses inside ten years or serious vehicular assault or homicide permanently block DUI hardship relief.

sec13-card-sec13-R25.question_text: Which six essential destinations can a court-ordered DUI restricted license authorize?
sec13-card-sec13-R25.teaching_text: Courts limit DUI hardship driving strictly to employment, school, faith services, court compliance, and interlock care.
sec13-card-sec13-R25.must_match_memory_hook: Work, college, worship, probation, treatment, interlock

visual_sync.text_span: Work, college, worship, probation, treatment, interlock

sec13-card-sec13-R26.question_text: When during a two-year DUI revocation may an offender seek an interlock-equipped restricted license?
sec13-card-sec13-R26.teaching_text: Serving one full year off the road comes first before interlock-monitored restricted driving can begin.

sec13-card-sec13-R27.question_text: Where does an adult suspended for frequent violations apply for a restricted license, and what is required?
sec13-card-sec13-R27.teaching_text: Point offenders apply administratively with approval paperwork, SR-twenty-two insurance, exams, and fees.

sec13-card-sec13-R28.question_text: Who can grant a restricted license after suspensions for implied consent, drag racing, or gas drive-offs?
sec13-card-sec13-R28.teaching_text: Court-imposed suspensions require the trial judge's order for limited work, college, or interlock travel.

sec13-card-sec13-R29.question_text: What limited travel can a minor suspended for drugs or alcohol request from the trial judge?
sec13-card-sec13-R29.teaching_text: Judges may preserve a teen's ride to classes or a part-time job while keeping recreational driving barred.

sec13-card-sec13-R30.question_text: What limited driving relief is available during a suspension for an unsatisfied traffic citation?
sec13-card-sec13-R30.teaching_text: Proving paid fines or an active court payment plan unlocks a certified order strictly for commuting.

sec13-card-sec13-F32.question_text: How many days do you have after departmental notice to submit a doctor's medical driving report?
sec13-card-sec13-F32.teaching_text: Meeting the thirty-day medical deadline keeps your case under physician review rather than automatic suspension.

sec13-card-sec13-F33.question_text: How long must a driver remain episode-free after losing consciousness from epilepsy, heart syncope, or diabetes?
sec13-card-sec13-F33.teaching_text: Six clean months verifies stable medical control before returning behind the wheel in live traffic.

sec13-card-sec13-F34.question_text: What happens if your driving ability is questioned and you ignore a re-exam or medical-report notice?
sec13-card-sec13-F34.teaching_text: Skipping a requested vision, written, road, or medical check automatically suspends your license.

sec13-card-sec13-R31.question_text: How long does suspension last when a submitted medical report comes back unfavorable?
sec13-card-sec13-R31.teaching_text: Driving privileges stay on hold until updated medical evidence shows safe vehicle control has returned.

sec13-card-sec13-F35.question_text: What does liability insurance cover compared with collision insurance and uninsured-motorist coverage?
sec13-card-sec13-F35.teaching_text: Knowing liability pays others' losses clarifies why liability alone never repairs your own crumpled fender.

sec13-card-sec13-F36.question_text: Is collision coverage mandatory, and when must Tennessee drivers show proof of financial responsibility?
sec13-card-sec13-F36.teaching_text: Fault does not matter—every driver involved in a crash or violation stop must prove financial responsibility.
sec13-card-sec13-F36.must_match_memory_hook: Collision optional; proof at stops, crashes

visual_sync.text_span: Collision optional; proof at stops, crashes

sec13-card-sec13-R32.question_text: Whom does Tennessee's Financial Responsibility Law protect the public against?
sec13-card-sec13-R32.teaching_text: Requiring coverage proof shields innocent crash victims from footing repair and hospital bills alone.

sec13-card-sec13-R33.question_text: Which two policy paperwork items count as valid proof of financial responsibility?
sec13-card-sec13-R33.teaching_text: A fresh coverage binder or current declarations sheet verifies active policy limits before cards arrive.

sec13-card-sec13-R34.question_text: Besides a declarations page or binder, which three items prove Tennessee financial responsibility?
sec13-card-sec13-R34.teaching_text: Most drivers carry an authorized insurer's card, while fleets or individuals may post bonds or self-insure.

sec13-card-sec13-F37.question_text: Which two state privileges get blocked after a conviction for failing to show financial responsibility?
sec13-card-sec13-F37.teaching_text: Driving uninsured freezes both your personal driver license and your vehicle's license plate renewal.

sec13-card-sec13-R39.question_text: When a crash claim is filed with the state against you, which three options prevent losing license and tags?
sec13-card-sec13-R39.teaching_text: Without active crash-date liability coverage, you must settle via notarized claimant releases or post bond.

sec13-card-sec13-R40.question_text: Before a financial-responsibility revocation starts, how and when must you ask for a hearing?
sec13-card-sec13-R40.teaching_text: Waiting past the printed effective date forfeits your right to an administrative pre-revocation hearing.

sec13-card-sec13-F38.question_text: Which crashes require immediate notice to local police, county sheriff, or Highway Patrol?
sec13-card-sec13-F38.teaching_text: Even a parking-lot dent easily exceeds fifty dollars, triggering mandatory immediate law-enforcement notice.

sec13-card-sec13-F39.question_text: What injury or single-person property-damage threshold makes a crash reportable to the Department of Safety?
sec13-card-sec13-F39.teaching_text: Notice the two distinct Tennessee numbers—fifty dollars for police call, four hundred dollars for state filing.

sec13-card-sec13-R35.question_text: Who must handle reporting a crash if injuries leave the driver unable to give notice?
sec13-card-sec13-R35.teaching_text: State law shifts notification duty onto any physically able passenger when the driver is incapacitated.

sec13-card-sec13-R36.question_text: What must you do if you strike an unattended vehicle or domestic animal and cannot locate its owner?
sec13-card-sec13-R36.teaching_text: Driving off because nobody was around turns a minor fender scrape into an unreported hit-and-run.

sec13-card-sec13-R38.question_text: Which two privileges can be suspended if you fail to file a required crash report?
sec13-card-sec13-R38.teaching_text: Skipping mandatory reporting puts both your driver license and your car's registration on suspension.

sec13-card-sec13-F41.question_text: Where must you stop immediately after a crash, and why turn off the ignition?
sec13-card-sec13-F41.teaching_text: Killing the engine immediately cuts electrical sparks near ruptured fuel lines while keeping lanes open.

sec13-card-sec13-F42.question_text: When are you allowed to move an injured person out of a wrecked vehicle?
sec13-card-sec13-F42.teaching_text: Moving someone with an unseen neck or spinal fracture without training risks permanent paralysis unless fire threatens.

sec13-card-sec13-R41.question_text: What immediate action is needed if a crashed vehicle catches fire?
sec13-card-sec13-R41.teaching_text: Putting distance between survivors and a burning vehicle protects everyone from heat, smoke, and explosion.

sec13-card-sec13-R42.question_text: Whom should you call quickly after a crash, and what mindset and location are required?
sec13-card-sec13-R42.teaching_text: Staying composed at the scene speeds accurate dispatch details and fulfills your legal duty to remain.

sec13-card-sec13-R43.question_text: Which details should you exchange with drivers and record from injured people and witnesses?
sec13-card-sec13-R43.teaching_text: Gathering witness contacts and plate numbers on-scene preserves crucial facts before bystanders drive off.

sec13-card-sec13-R44.question_text: Whose ownership and policy numbers must you also record, and whom should you notify promptly?
sec13-card-sec13-R44.teaching_text: Sometimes a borrowed car's owner differs from its driver, so recording owner and policy details matters.

sec13-card-sec13-F43.question_text: If you encounter a crash without rescue training, how should you help without causing trouble?
sec13-card-sec13-F43.teaching_text: Stopping untrained clogs shoulder access for ambulances and triggers rear-end chain collisions behind you.

sec13-card-sec13-R45.question_text: What three steps should you take if you actually witnessed a crash happen?
sec13-card-sec13-R45.teaching_text: Neutral eyewitness accounts give investigating troopers objective clarity on signals, speeds, and fault.

sec13-card-sec13-R46.question_text: What driver behavior near an active crash scene triggers secondary collisions?
sec13-card-sec13-R46.teaching_text: Taking eyes off the bumper ahead to gawk at flashing lights rear-ends slowing traffic instantly.

sec16-card-sec16-F01.question_text: Besides people walking on foot, which mobility users count as pedestrians under Tennessee law?
sec16-card-sec16-F01.teaching_text: Both motorized and manual wheelchair users hold full pedestrian rights at crosswalks and intersections.

sec16-card-sec16-F02.question_text: Where do pedestrians generally hold right-of-way, and do unpainted intersections still contain crosswalks?
sec16-card-sec16-F02.teaching_text: Test questions trap drivers who think missing white paint removes a pedestrian's legal intersection right-of-way.

sec16-card-sec16-F03.question_text: Even when technical right-of-way favors your car, what legal duty still governs driving near pedestrians?
sec16-card-sec16-F03.teaching_text: Having a green light never excuses striking a person on foot when extreme care could avoid impact.

sec16-card-sec16-F04.question_text: Why must no part of your bumper sit across a crosswalk while waiting on red or turning?
sec16-card-sec16-F04.teaching_text: Overhanging the crosswalk pushes walkers out around your hood right into live moving lanes.
sec16-card-sec16-F04.must_match_memory_hook: Blocking crosswalks forces walkers into traffic

visual_sync.text_span: Blocking crosswalks forces walkers into traffic

sec16-card-sec16-R01.question_text: Which four groups of pedestrians suffer the highest share of car-pedestrian collisions?
sec16-card-sec16-R01.teaching_text: Slower crossing pace, impaired judgment, or unpredictable moves put these four groups at highest risk.

sec16-card-sec16-R02.question_text: At what positions inside a crosswalk does a pedestrian trigger your legal duty to yield?
sec16-card-sec16-R02.teaching_text: You must yield whenever a walker occupies your side or steps close enough from the far half to face danger.
sec16-card-sec16-R02.must_match_memory_hook: Your road half or approaching closely

visual_sync.text_span: Your road half or approaching closely

sec16-card-sec16-R03.question_text: Which side of your car needs special pedestrian checks, particularly during right turns?
sec16-card-sec16-R03.teaching_text: Drivers staring left for a gap in cross traffic easily miss a pedestrian stepping off the right-hand curb.

sec16-card-sec16-R04.question_text: Which pedestrians are hardest to see and least predictable, and near what five places must you slow?
sec16-card-sec16-R04.teaching_text: Small stature hides kids behind parked hoods near bus stops, playgrounds, schools, parks, and ice-cream trucks.

sec16-card-sec16-R05.question_text: Who gets right-of-way across driveways, alleys, or garage exits, and what horn or engine move is forbidden?
sec16-card-sec16-R05.teaching_text: Sidewalk users hold priority across every driveway cut, and blasting horns or revving engines startles people dangerously.
sec16-card-sec16-R05.must_match_memory_hook: Yield sidewalks; never honk or rev

visual_sync.text_span: Yield sidewalks; never honk or rev

sec16-card-sec16-F05.question_text: How long must you remain stopped for a crossing pedestrian when school-zone warning flashers are active?
sec16-card-sec16-F05.teaching_text: Rolling forward as soon as a child clears your bumper breaks Tennessee's full-roadway school-zone stop rule.

sec16-card-sec16-F06.question_text: Which two visual cues identify a blind pedestrian who always receives full right-of-way?
sec16-card-sec16-F06.teaching_text: Spotting that distinctive mobility cane or harnessed guide dog requires drivers to stop and yield unconditionally.
